clue.text: Part of home stereo system for politician

explanation.walkthrough: The phrase reads straight as a piece of hi-fi kit owned by a household, and as the title of the House's presiding officer.
explanation.definitionFit: The holder of that office is an elected member of Congress, so a political figure in every sense.
